Locke sustains through chip damage (Soul Ignition (W)) — Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades.
Locke bypasses stacking resistances (Soul Ignition (W)) — raw armour or MR is the wrong answer here.
Locke's combo opens with an auto-attack reset (Ashen Pursuit (E)) — the wind-up is your cue to step back, not the ability cast.
Locke applies on-hit through Silver Stake (P) — their damage scales with attack speed, so armour alone reads the trade wrong.
